title: query.run raises KeyError when importing a CSV file
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Lattice version 3.2.9; operating system Ubuntu 24.04 LTS;
server region us-west-2.

STEPS:

Steps to reproduce:
* Open Lattice and begin importing a CSV file.
* Edit the settings file and use the renamed key.
* Watch the log for the traceback below.

EXPECTED:

As on every earlier run, importing a CSV file should just
complete.

ACTUAL:

The missing key is the old name of a setting that was
renamed. Following the release notes we renamed that key in
the settings file.

FREQUENCY:

Reproduces only on the first run after login.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:46 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:88 in on_import
lattice/io/batch.py:55 in run_import
lattice/store/query.py:151 in run
KeyError: 'legacy_id'
